title: Choose the visual world for fairprice.broker
question: Your August ruling pinned The Instrument. Here it is beside the two challengers that held their own, with the discipline they donate written in. Keep it, take a challenger, or roll again.

options.label: The Instrument
options.lineage: pinned by your 19 Aug ruling: Stripe-calm shell, tactile meter, living reveal
options.thesis: A quiet instrument you set in private, and a reveal where two ranges drift into one fair number.
options.viewport: Headline and one gold action on the left, the sealed four-point meter as a raised panel on the right, the live reveal band running full width beneath with the fair price landing.
options.risk: Neumorphism goes mushy without hard text contrast and a strict shadow scale; the reveal must never delay the sixty-second promise.

raised.raise: The fair price lands as one lit figure; every numeral on the site is tabular and sized from the same digit scale.
The convergence leaves a fading wake rather than snapping: motion has memory, and rest returns to calm.
All four price points stay visible as ghosts on the meter; only the one being set is struck forward.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: The numbers are the interface: every price a glowing digit in glass, agreement a count that settles.
materials: orange plasma digits in glass envelopes
options.viewport: Two tube banks face each other across a dark bench; the fair price bank in the middle lights up as the visitor plays.
options.case: Wins on product clarity: the fair price is unmistakably the point. Loses audience identification: recruiters and candidates need calm trust, not a lab at night.
options.risk: Reads as retro gadgetry; dark ground fights the neutral-broker trust position.

options.label: Bioluminescent Wake
options.thesis: Two hands draw light through black water and the wakes meet where the price is fair.
options.viewport: A full-bleed dark field; dragging the meter draws a glowing wake, the two wakes converge and a bright point holds where they meet.
options.case: Wins audience identification on 'viscerally engaging' (your own brief). Loses product clarity: a dark, ambient surface makes who-sees-what and the four questions harder to read.
options.risk: Spectacle before understanding; heavy for phones passed hand to hand.

options.label: Struck Cathode Gauze
options.lineage: cathode numeral stacks behind anode gauze
options.thesis: Every possible value present as a ghost; the chosen one struck forward in glow.
options.viewport: An unframed dark plane of ghost values with one lit.
options.case: Loses both axes for this audience: an access-control aesthetic on a trust product.
options.kept: All options present as ghosts, one struck forward.

options.label: Window-Box Toy Shelf
options.thesis: Every check is a box with a window; lift the lid to see inside.
options.viewport: Shelves of boxed checks, one lid hinging open.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful to the point of undermining a salary conversation.
options.kept: Progressive disclosure as a physical hinge: summary on the lid, detail inside.

options.label: Expedition Ice Press
options.thesis: One black ink, hand-set, errors left standing.
options.viewport: A narrow hand-set measure with a tipped-in plate.
options.case: Loses both axes: a reading world, not an instrument to set.
options.kept: Honesty as material: what was entered stays visible, uncorrected.
options.risk: Static where the product needs motion.

options.label: Hand-Processed Film
options.thesis: The emulsion joins the event: light leaks and scratches mark the frame.
options.viewport: Frames banded in strict rows, the active frame flared.
options.case: Loses both axes: cinematic wear reads as damage on a fairness tool.
options.kept: The reveal leaves a mark on the medium: the moment of agreement is recorded, not just shown.
options.risk: Grain and scratches read as broken UI.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Stripe-class SaaS landing page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, subhead, two buttons, a product screenshot floating below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other tool by design; the reveal becomes a feature bullet.
